description: This file is a shell script containing helper functions and commands for managing and orchestrating Docker containers related to OpenClaw. It includes functionalities such as starting/stopping containers, managing configuration, handling device pairings, updating images, and opening UI dashboards.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out warning lines from output

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Trims surrounding quotes from input value

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads configuration directory from config file

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures the CLAWDOCK_DIR is set and valid, with auto-detection

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Runs docker compose commands with appropriate files

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from environment file
